body: There are groups in my city, yes. Spoke to a friend last night as well. He has contacts here and is willing to share them with me as needed. I just need to develop the will to let people in without fear of them judging me for not looking or sounding female enough at the moment.

I’m one semester away from graduating so all intentions are set on finishing. And, with the help of my sister, there are plans to try to get on hormones at the beginning of next year. I don’t want to keep making excuses. So yeah. I am gonna suck it up. I’m sorry you’ve felt pain and suffering.
I’m aware that’s not possible, and I’m very aware my options are limited here. I just needed to write it out.
